projects.title: Butterfly gardens
projects.summary: Building butterfly gardens at assisted living facilities so residents can enjoy butterflies up close.
projects.description:
This project honors my great-grandmother, who loved butterflies. After she passed, I started raising butterflies in my backyard with native flowering plants.

I’ve finished my first garden at an assisted living facility, where we released butterflies with the residents, showed them the butterflies up close, and gave them a book to keep. I’m now working on building more.
